intro: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a polished landscape 16:9 introduction banner for the existing MINI SUMO browser party game. Reference image 2 supplies Japanese shrine arena setting and visual style only, do NOT include gameplay UI. Wide cinematic advertising key art: left 43% has large readable MINI SUMO title with wooden plaque and red-white rope, under it exact small copy 'PUSH. DASH. WIN.' and below '2–4 PLAYER PARTY GAME'. Right 57% shows four adorable round topknotted sumo wrestlers with red, blue, green and yellow mawashi pushing and bouncing on a straw-edged dohyo. Dynamic playful action, friendly competition, expressive faces; clear silhouette. Japanese festival shrine background, vermilion torii, lanterns, cream clouds and indigo depth. Premium matching illustrated mobile game art; rich golden highlights, warm vermilion, beautiful dusk blue. Keep entire composition and all text within generous 6% safe margins. No UI controls, no app-store badges, no watermarks, no invented logos. Output 1920x1080 landscape.
